name: Apocalypse Rising
desc:
Apocalypse Rising is an open world zombie survival game where the zombies aren't the only threat. Group up, repair vehicles, build bases, eliminate the infected, and watch out for hostile survivors!

Apocalypse Rising VIP servers are FREE! 

Backpacks and vests from the game are available for your Roblox avatar here: https://www.roblox.com/catalog?Category=11&Subcategory=19&CreatorName=Gusmanak
